title: NetExec / CrackMapExec SMB and Network Execution Runner
goal: Add a NetExec runner for SMB enumeration, share discovery, null session testing, and authenticated access validation across discovered hosts — the industry-standard tool for internal network lateral movement assessment.
scope: Implement a 'netexec' runner in workers/runners/netexec/ that wraps NetExec (nxc, successor to CrackMapExec, available on Kali). Two execution tiers: (1) PASSIVE tier — null session / unauthenticated SMB enumeration: host reachability, OS version fingerprint, SMB signing status, open shares, null session access. No credentials required. (2) INTRUSIVE tier (requires approval gate + auth context) — authenticated SMB: enumerate logged-on users, local admin accounts, shared drive contents listing, pass-the-hash validation using credential material from secrets_refs captured in earlier phases. Each tier is a separate run profile. Results normalized to findings: SMB signing disabled (high), null session access (medium-high), pass-the-hash success (critical), exposed shares with sensitive content patterns (high). All credential material passed via secrets_refs — never hardcoded in params. Output artifacts stored per host. Credential material from pass-the-hash tests stored as encrypted finding evidence, never in plain text.
generation_reason: NetExec/CrackMapExec is the most-used tool in internal network assessments after nmap. It validates SMB signing, lateral movement potential, and credential reuse across the network. NodeZero and Pentera both include SMB assessment as core internal capabilities. Without it, AegisPT cannot assess whether captured credentials work across the network.

constraints.active_task_gate: Do not implement this task until it is the single active task in NEXT_TASK.md.
constraints.scope_creep_guard: Intrusive tier requires explicit approval gate and auth context from secrets_refs. No credential material in plain text. Scope allowlist enforced. No remote code execution in this slice (covered in backlog-74). No account lockout — use only confirmed credentials, not spraying.

success_criteria: netexec runner passive tier enumerates SMB hosts without credentials.

Intrusive tier requires approval gate and auth context.
Pass-the-hash success produces critical finding with encrypted evidence.
No credential material in plain text in any output.
Two run profiles: passive-lan-smb-enum and intrusive-lan-smb-auth.
Tests cover passive enumeration, intrusive gate, no-plaintext enforcement, scope enforcement.

acceptance_criteria: Passive and intrusive tiers work correctly.
